visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free (entry via France - Schengen rules apply).
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No visa: Monaco is reached through France (no border controls), so the Schengen 90 days in 180 rule applies in practice.
steps: Monaco isn't a Schengen member but has an open border with France; time there counts in practice.
At the first Schengen border, give fingerprints and a photo for the Entry/Exit System (EES); it's free.
Stays over 90 days need a national visa or a bilateral waiver arranged before travel.
